crossRefs.note: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in its wide places, if you can…
But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the…
Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved…
Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
“Enter in by the narrow gate; for wide is the gate and broad is the way that leads to destruction, and many are those…
But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in…
Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
translations.bsb: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, and all the women standing by—a great assembly—along with all the people living in the land of Egypt and in Pathros, said to Jeremiah,
translations.kjv: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
translations.asv: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great assembly, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
